sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 2)

purpose.zh: 练手腕和肩，体会身体压到手上的感觉
purpose.en: Builds your wrists and shoulders and teaches you to put your weight on your hands.

text.zh: 膝盖顶住上臂外侧，身体往前倾到脚尖离地
text.en: Knees on the backs of your arms, lean until your toes lift

text.zh: 手指张开抓地，别把重量全压在掌根。
text.en: Spread your fingers and grip the floor, not all weight on the heel of your hand.

text.zh: 肩往前送、往下沉，别只是往前倒。
text.en: Shoulders go forward and down, don't just tip over.

commonErrors.en: Just falling forward without pressing the shoulders down.

commonErrors.zh: 手指没抓地，重量全在掌根
commonErrors.en: Fingers loose, all the weight on the heel of the hand.

cautions.zh: 怕往前栽，就在脸前面放个枕头
cautions.en: If you're worried about tipping forward, put a pillow in front of your face.

cautions.zh: 脚尖离不了地，就先踮着脚把重量往手上送
cautions.en: If your toes won't lift yet, stay on tiptoe and shift weight to your hands.

thomasSupplement.camera: 正侧面为主（看前倾角度和脚离地）
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
